name: Own the milestone final repository quality pass
content:
All selected stories in milestone {{runtime.milestone_id}}, including those already Done, have passed the workflow's saved Done/all-checked verification.

In {{project.spoke_root}}, follow AGENTS.md and {{project.hub_root}}/.agents/skills/work/SKILL.md. This task owns the normal repository quality gate. Full quality requires an explicit push/install preparation instruction.

Run the gate, repair in-scope failures and rerun after meaningful changes: at most five invocations within 60 minutes. Preserve exit/timeout evidence. Stop on an unresolved external obstruction, unchanged failure or exhausted budget; do not delete caches, weaken tests or extend limits. Leave no owned background processes and do not modify planning records.

Return one JSON object:
{"result":"passed|blocked","gate":"actual command","attempts":1,"blocker":null}
Passed requires an observed successful gate; blocked requires a specific nonempty blocker. Report the actual invocation count.
